verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API/MCP/agent docs cover booking, rescheduling, and availability-checking for meetings between people, but there is no evidence of AI converting personal tasks into calendar time-blocks around existing meetings/deadlines or autonomously re-planning those blocks when things change — that is a distinct task-scheduling capability not documented here. missing for 10: task-to-calendar-block conversion, deadline-aware planning logic, autonomous re-planning of task blocks on schedule changes.
